# Vesta to Host 2026 Investor Day, Presenting Route 2030 Strategy Update and Financial Framework


November 11, 2026 8:00 AM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_bb0dd941965aa0b6ec2fe07f4a4d8a49/vesta/news/2026-11-11_Vesta_to_Host_2026_Investor_Day_Presenting_Route_158.pdf)


MEXICO CITY--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta, S.A.B. de C.V. (NYSE: VTMX; BMV: VESTA) (“Vesta” or the “Company”), a leading industrial real estate company in Mexico, will host its 2026 Investor Day today in New York City, with participation available both in person and via live webcast.


During the event, Vesta's management team will present an update to the Company's Route 2030 strategic plan, outlining its development program, long-term growth objectives, and financial framework. The presentations will highlight Vesta's strategic priorities, its approach to capital allocation, and the key drivers of value creation through 2030.


Under its updated Route 2030 framework, Vesta is targeting a portfolio of approximately 60 million square feet of gross leasable area (GLA) by 2030 with an investment plan of more than US$ 1 billion from 2026 to 2030. The Company’s financial targets for 2030 include approximately US$ 480 million in annual total revenue and US$ 320 million in pre tax FFO.


The Investor Day presentation will be available on Vesta's investor relations website ahead of the event.


**Investor Day Webcast**


Management presentations will begin at 9:00 a.m. ET and will include live question-and-answer sessions.


Investors, analysts, and other interested parties may access the live webcast and presentation materials at Vesta’s investor relations website and on[www.vestaday.com](http://www.vestaday.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available following the event on Vesta’s investor relations website and on[www.vestaday.com](http://www.vestaday.com/) .


**About Vesta**


Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta, S.A.B. de C.V. is a Mexican industrial real estate company engaged in the development, acquisition, ownership, and management of industrial buildings and distribution centers in Mexico. Vesta's shares trade on the Mexican Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol VESTA, and its American Depositary Shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol VTMX.


**Forward-Looking Statements**
